parameters.name: TimeSelector
parameters.label: Time Selector
parameters.query:
datatable(value:string, label:string, ord:long)[
    "startofday(now())","Today",0,
    "ago(1d)","Last 24 Hours",1,
    "ago(7d)","Last 7 Days",2,
    "ago(30d)","Last 30 Days",3,
    "ago(90d)","Last 90 Days",4,
    "datetime(2000-01-01)","All Time",5
]
| order by ord asc
| project value, label

parameters.name: PolicyGroup
parameters.label: Policy Group / Name Filter
parameters.query:
let policies = ASimProcessEventAirlockDigital
| where isnotempty(RuleName)
| distinct RuleName
| extend ord = 1;
union (datatable(RuleName:string, ord:long)['All', 0]), policies
| order by ord asc, RuleName asc
| project RuleName

parameters.name: ExecutionType
parameters.label: Execution Type Filter
parameters.query:
datatable(value:string, label:string, ord:long)[
    "All","All",0,
    "0","Trusted Execution",1,
    "1","Blocked Execution",2,
    "2","Untrusted Execution [Audit]",3,
    "3","Untrusted Execution [OTP]",4,
    "4","Trusted Path Execution",5,
    "5","Trusted Publisher Execution",6,
    "6","Blocklist Execution",7,
    "7","Blocklist Execution [Audit]",8,
    "8","Trusted Process Execution",9,
    "9","Constrained Execution",10,
    "10","Trusted Metadata Execution",11,
    "11","Trusted Browser Execution",12,
    "12","Blocked Browser Execution",13,
    "13","Untrusted Browser Execution [Audit]",14,
    "14","Untrusted Browser Execution [OTP]",15,
    "15","Blocklist Browser Execution [Audit]",16,
    "16","Blocklist Browser Execution",17,
    "17","Trusted Installer Execution",18,
    "18","Trusted Browser Metadata Execution",19
]
| order by ord asc
| project value, label

content.query:
ASimProcessEventAirlockDigital
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeSelector}
| where '{PolicyGroup}' == 'All' or RuleName == '{PolicyGroup}'
| where '{ExecutionType}' == 'All' or EventOriginalType == '{ExecutionType}'
| extend EventTypeName = case(
    EventOriginalType == '0', 'Trusted Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '1', 'Blocked Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '2', 'Untrusted Execution [Audit]',
    EventOriginalType == '3', 'Untrusted Execution [OTP]',
    EventOriginalType == '4', 'Trusted Path Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '5', 'Trusted Publisher Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '6', 'Blocklist Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '7', 'Blocklist Execution [Audit]',
    EventOriginalType == '8', 'Trusted Process Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '9', 'Constrained Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '10', 'Trusted Metadata Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '11', 'Trusted Browser Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '12', 'Blocked Browser Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '13', 'Untrusted Browser Execution [Audit]',
    EventOriginalType == '14', 'Untrusted Browser Execution [OTP]',
    EventOriginalType == '15', 'Blocklist Browser Execution [Audit]',
    EventOriginalType == '16', 'Blocklist Browser Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '17', 'Trusted Installer Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '18', 'Trusted Browser Metadata Execution',
    isnotempty(EventOriginalType), EventOriginalType,
    strcat('Unknown (', EventOriginalType, ')'))
| summarize Count = count() by EventTypeName
| order by Count desc
content.title: Execution Types

content.query:
let data = ASimProcessEventAirlockDigital
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeSelector}
| where '{PolicyGroup}' == 'All' or RuleName == '{PolicyGroup}'
| where '{ExecutionType}' == 'All' or EventOriginalType == '{ExecutionType}';
union
    (data | where (EventOriginalType in ('1','6','7','12','15','16') or EventOriginalType has_any ('Blocked', 'Blocklist')) | summarize Value = count() | extend Metric = 'Blocked Executions (Total)', Mode = 'Total', Category = 'Blocked', ord = 0),
    (data | where (EventOriginalType in ('1','6','7','12','15','16') or EventOriginalType has_any ('Blocked', 'Blocklist')) | summarize Value = dcount(TargetProcessSHA256) | extend Metric = 'Blocked Executions (Unique)', Mode = 'Unique', Category = 'Blocked', ord = 1),
    (data | where (EventOriginalType in ('2','3','9','13','14') or EventOriginalType has_any ('Untrusted', 'Constrained')) | summarize Value = count() | extend Metric = 'Untrusted Executions (Total)', Mode = 'Total', Category = 'Untrusted', ord = 2),
    (data | where (EventOriginalType in ('2','3','9','13','14') or EventOriginalType has_any ('Untrusted', 'Constrained')) | summarize Value = dcount(TargetProcessName) | extend Metric = 'Untrusted Executions (Unique)', Mode = 'Unique', Category = 'Untrusted', ord = 3)
| order by ord asc
| project Metric, Value, Mode, Category
content.title: Blocked / Untrusted Files

content.query:
ASimProcessEventAirlockDigital
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(365d)
| where '{PolicyGroup}' == 'All' or RuleName == '{PolicyGroup}'
| where '{ExecutionType}' == 'All' or EventOriginalType == '{ExecutionType}'
| summarize ['Received Date'] = min(TimeGenerated) by ['File Name'] = TargetProcessName, Publisher = TargetProcessFileCompany
| where ['Received Date'] >= {TimeSelector}
| where isnotempty(['File Name'])
| project ['Received Date'], ['File Name'], Publisher
| top 100 by ['Received Date'] desc
content.title: New Files Seen
Files for: {SelectedMetric}

content.query:
let blocked = dynamic(['1','6','7','12','15','16']);
let untrusted = dynamic(['2','3','9','13','14']);
let cat = '{MetricCategory}';
ASimProcessEventAirlockDigital
| where TimeGenerated >= {TimeSelector}
| where '{PolicyGroup}' == 'All' or RuleName == '{PolicyGroup}'
| where '{ExecutionType}' == 'All' or EventOriginalType == '{ExecutionType}'
| where (cat == 'Blocked' and (EventOriginalType in (blocked) or EventOriginalType has_any ('Blocked', 'Blocklist')))
     or (cat == 'Untrusted' and (EventOriginalType in (untrusted) or EventOriginalType has_any ('Untrusted', 'Constrained')))
| extend EventTypeName = case(
    EventOriginalType == '1', 'Blocked Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '2', 'Untrusted Execution [Audit]',
    EventOriginalType == '3', 'Untrusted Execution [OTP]',
    EventOriginalType == '6', 'Blocklist Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '7', 'Blocklist Execution [Audit]',
    EventOriginalType == '9', 'Constrained Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '12', 'Blocked Browser Execution',
    EventOriginalType == '13', 'Untrusted Browser Execution [Audit]',
    EventOriginalType == '14', 'Untrusted Browser Execution [OTP]',
    EventOriginalType == '15', 'Blocklist Browser Execution [Audit]',
    EventOriginalType == '16', 'Blocklist Browser Execution',
    EventOriginalType)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ['File Name'] = TargetProcessName, ['Execution Type'] = EventTypeName, Publisher = TargetProcessFileCompany, RuleName, SHA256 = TargetProcessSHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 1000
content.title: Files for: {SelectedMetric}
